rung_why: cost is a tie (3.9% spread across rungs, band 10%), so the tie-break is the one yield column where the rungs separate: one-per-cluster class-4 rate

cspacing_basis.recipe: library morph CLIP (robustz_tanh_k2_v1, 640x360ss2, vit_base_patch16_clip_224.openai) at cos >= 0.974
cspacing_basis.rule: the coarsest |delta c| bucket boundary at which the near-dup rate reaches the different-atom baseline
cspacing_basis.note: one c per ATOM is NOT sufficient: different atoms at 1e-4..1e-3 are 38% near-dup

note: first-wins thinning ACROSS channels in measured-yield order; the ordering is the policy
